title: Brand Ecom Full-Stack Agency Yinghang Tianxia Raises ¥10M Series A from Insight
summary: On May 5, 2022, content+data brand ecom full-stack agency Yinghang Tianxia (影行天下) (founded 2015; long-form ads/net film → short-video MCN on Douyin/Kuaishou from 2019) closed a ¥10M Series A solely from listed Insight Group (因赛) — 2nd round (Pre-A Gushengtang) — for IP creator
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Company / Funding · May 19, 2022

On May 5, 2022, content+data brand ecom full-stack agency Yinghang Tianxia (影行天下) (founded 2015; long-form ads/net film → short-video MCN on Douyin/Kuaishou from 2019) closed a ¥10M Series A solely from listed Insight Group (因赛) — 2nd round (Pre-A Gushengtang) — for IP creator incubation and interest ecom. First-batch Douyin MCN and Blue-V full-effect partner; 100+ brand logos (realme, OnePlus, Honor, iQOO, Midea, Gree…). Brand short-video + store live DP + creator matrix.

— END —
